accounting.pflop_per_episode: 2 × parameter count × (uncached prompt tokens + generated tokens), summed over all models, divided by 1e15
accounting.model_seconds_per_episode: Estimated steps/episode × (7.96 s/step five-candidate actor generation on one H200 + measured selector s/step); excludes browser time
accounting.aggregation: Equal-weight mean across OM2W, WebVoyager and DeepShop
caveats: Best-of-Q embedder state text estimated at 300 tokens/step, a slight compute undercount.
PRO-CUA and WebDreamer share the actor GPU and slow actor generation; their model-second estimates are lower bounds.
